statusDetail: The verified keyframes and continuous 15-second mechanical sequence are available. The review uses a cross-browser H.264 delivery composited onto the exact Ti-Scale canvas color; the transparent VP9 and untouched 4K Higgsfield masters remain preserved.

stages.label: Locked assembly
stages.summary: The approved Ti-Scale core remains intact while the production sequence establishes its exact geometry, material, camera, and light.
stages.imageAlt: Assembled sculptural Ti-Scale core rendered in light titanium and graphite with a transparent background.

stages.label: Engineering explosion
stages.summary: The same titanium components separate along their real seams and joint normals, exposing a credible reassemblable mechanical system without changing the core identity.
stages.imageAlt: Transparent-background exploded engineering view of the same Ti-Scale titanium core with its original components separated along visible seams.

stages.label: Architectural chassis
stages.summary: The titanium assembly resolves into a shadow-free physical chassis reserved for accessible live interface modules; no rendered dashboard data is embedded in the artwork.
stages.imageAlt: Transparent-background titanium and graphite architectural chassis assembled from the Ti-Scale material system.
